title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Drawable gutter thumbnails now refresh reliably when files are edited or saved.

highlights.title: Gutter Thumbnail Reliability
highlights.description: Vector drawable previews in the gutter now update correctly after every edit and save — stale thumbnails no longer persist when you modify a drawable file.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Fixed drawable gutter thumbnails to refresh reliably on every file edit and save, so the preview in the gutter always reflects the current state of the drawable.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: No changes to navigation, indexing, code folding, inlay hints, Gradle integration, or any other feature since v1.18.1.
